title: The See-Saw Stuck on One Side
youtube_title: The See-Saw Stuck on One Side | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Saving a place is a way of saying you belong.
summary: At a meadow gate where games start, Arun is just outside the fun, close to a see-saw stuck down because the other seat was empty. Vera changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Arun has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Mr. Ade lets the children solve it.
